tnotes.discrepancy: The 1907-08 roster reprints her (no. 39, p. 48) with the death line AND a full tally «Въ 14 балетахъ—48; въ 1 дивертисментѣ—1; въ 10 операхъ—72. Всего—121 разъ». A dancer who died in February 1907 cannot have danced in 1907-08. The tallies probably belong one place down: 121 to Надежда Михайловна (printed 3-я, 53; she had 122 in 1906-07) and 53 to Надежда Сергѣевна (printed 4-я, joined 1 Aug 1907, no tally), who danced as 2-я and 3-я that season (1907-08 reviews; 1908-09 roster). Tallies left as printed.

jub.evidence_english: Artist of the SP ballet troupe; graduated from the SP Theatre School in 1895 into the corps de ballet (service from 1 June 1895).
jub.notes: Spelled «Мессарошъ» (double с, ш) in heading, text and caption. Died of consumption aged 18. Named in the ballet season review.

tnotes.research_reading: continuing service; the printed «†» is a print error
tnotes.discrepancy: The 1902-03 Moscow list prints «† 1 декабря 1902 г.» under her (p.108, no. 69), but every later volume lists her (same start «съ 1 сентября 1901 г.», no death line), with 72 to 87 performances a season and review mentions to 1907-08. No other death near 1 Dec 1902 appears anywhere in the data, so the line does not look misplaced from a neighbour. research.service_period drops the end (service_period_date_corrections.csv) and research.person_death therefore has no death for her.
tnotes.corroboration_found: tallies 1903-04..1910-11; review mentions 1903-08; role assertion 1908-02-22 (фея канареекъ)
tnotes.corroboration_wanted: RGIA personnel дело; a 1902-03 Moscow obituary or death notice (none in the Yearbook)

periods.date_correction: end printed «1 декабря 1902 г.» is a print error, not used: p.108 no.69 prints «† 1 декабря 1902 г.» under Николаева 3-я (scan read by Claude; crop docs/eval/scan_audit/1902-03_balletartists_MSK_p108_no69_nikolaeva3_death_line.png), but she is listed every season 1903-04..1910-11 with the same start (2-я from 1909-10), tallies 72 (1903-04) to 87 (1910-11), 13 review mentions 1903-08, a role assertion dated 1908-02-22; no other death near 1 Dec 1902 in the data (RG 2026-11-03: "Yes, print error")

jub.role: first balletmaster (from 24 May 1862); formerly premier danseur and mime; teacher of ballet dances at the Theatre School 1855-1886
jub.dates: 50 years' service with the Imperial Theatres (service from 24 May 1847, debut 26 September 1847); jubilee celebrated 8 December 1896 at the first performance of «Синяя борода» (his benefit); banquet 9 December 1896; born Marseille 1822
jub.evidence_verbatim: (Біографическій очеркъ, по поводу 50-ти-лѣтія его артистической службы при Императорскихъ театрахъ)
jub.evidence_english: biographical sketch on the 50th anniversary of his artistic service at the Imperial Theatres
jub.notes: [Printed as a stand-alone article, not under a Юбилеи/Некрологи heading; occasion: a jubilee.] Heading verbatim: «М. И. Петипа.»; subtitle verbatim: «(Біографическій очеркъ, по поводу 50-ти-лѣтія его артистической службы при Императорскихъ театрахъ).» Separate portrait plate, caption «Маріусъ Ивановичъ Петипа.», credit «Съ фотографіи А. А. Петрова автотипія Ангерера и Гёшля (въ Вѣнѣ).»; pdf p.3 is its blank verso. Article complete (tailpiece on p.433). Ballet content: family (father Жанъ Петипа, brother Люціанъ), early career Nantes, Paris, Bordeaux, Spain; engaged for Petersburg on Титюсъ's recommendation, debut 26 September 1847 in «Пахита» as графъ д'Эрвильи, replacing Эмиль Гредлю; August 1848 staged «Пахита» and «Сатанилла» in Moscow; influence of Жюль Перро; married Марья Сергѣевна Суровщикова 1854; pupils Гердтъ and Никитинъ. First new ballet «Бракъ во время регенства» 18 December 1858; a dated list of some 40 ballets follows, from «Парижскій рынокъ» and «Голубая георгина» (1859) and «Дочь фараона» (for Розатти) through «Царь Кандавлъ» (1868, for Генріета Доръ), «Донъ-Кихотъ» (1871), «Баядерка» (1877), «Спящая красавица» (1890), «Лебединое озеро» (1895, with Л. И. Ивановъ) to «Синяя борода»; also 16 revivals, separate dances, opera dances and seven ballets composed abroad. Best roles: Конрадъ («Корсаръ»), Фаустъ, the hussar officer in «Пахита». Jubilee evening: first greeted by Л. И. Ивановъ, deputations from opera, orchestra, French and Russian drama and the Italian ballet; he received the «знакъ для заслуженныхъ артистовъ», said to be the first such award to a choreographic artist. Oddity: the list on p.429 dates «Синяя борода» «(1897 г.)» while p.431 gives its first performance as 8 December 1896 - as printed. The banquet speaker is printed only as «К. А. Ск—скій».

jub.evidence_english: On 8 December at the Mariinsky the benefit of the chief ballet master M. I. Petipa, given for 50 years of service; Bluebeard was premiered.
